name: Boracay
summary: Boracay is a small island famous for White Beach, four kilometres of powder-fine sand. Sail on a paraw at sunset, island-hop to snorkelling spots, kitesurf at Bulabog Beach and climb Mount Luho for views.
seasonNote: November to May is dry; the habagat monsoon brings rain and waves from June to October.
arrival: Fly to Caticlan (closest) or Kalibo, then a short boat across.
cashTip: Carry pesos for tricycles, island fees and small eateries; resorts take cards.
foodTip: Fresh seafood at D'Talipapa and chori burgers.
